description: This file defines inductor-specific tensor operations and functions for the PyTorch library, including custom implementations for matrix multiplication, tensor allocation, reinterpretation, and gradient accumulation, along with registration of these functions within the inductor namespace.

methods.name: _mm_plus_mm_out
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication of tensors a and b, adds the result of c and d to the output tensor, and returns the output.

methods.name: _mm_plus_mm
methods.description: Wrapper around _mm_plus_mm_out that provides a more convenient interface for matrix multiplication and addition.

methods.name: _alloc_from_pool
methods.description: Allocates a tensor from a memory pool with specified offset, dtype, size, and stride.

methods.name: _reinterpret_tensor
methods.description: Reinterprets a tensor with new size and stride, adding an offset increment to the storage offset.

methods.name: accumulate_grad_
methods.description: Accumulates gradient for a variable tensor, handling both regular and meta device tensors.
